headlines.title_en: A-shares close: Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext both up over 1%; real estate and consumer stocks rally broadly.
headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite Index oscillated narrowly throughout the day, while the Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext both rose over 1%. Consumer stocks strengthened collectively, with Yiming Food hitting a 3-day limit-up, and multiple stocks such as Jinshiyuan and Anji Food hitting limit-up. The real estate sector rallied, with Jingtou Development hitting a 3-day limit-up, and Binjiang Group and Seazen Holdings among those hitting limit-up. Computing hardware stocks rebounded, with Raybow Optoelectronics, Jingwang Electronics, and Yongding Shares hitting limit-up. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 4,100 stocks rising across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, with turnover at 2.17 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.32%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.09%, and the ChiNext rose 1.49%. 2. In terms of sectors, real estate, major consumer, computing hardware, and semiconductor chips led gains, while oil and gas, coal, beauty care, and banking fell against the trend. 3. A total of 3,860 stocks rose across the two markets, with 95 hitting limit-up, 1,217 falling, none hitting limit-down, and 11 stocks breaking their limit-up.

headlines.title_en: A-share market review: ChiNext opens low, closes up 1.49%; large consumer stocks active in afternoon.
headlines.summary_en: A-shares' three major indices rose collectively today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.32%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.09%, the ChiNext Index rose 1.49%, the Beijing Stock Exchange 50 rose 0.23%, and the STAR 50 Index rose 1.61%. Total market turnover was 2.1672 trillion yuan, shrinking by 168.4 billion yuan from the previous day, with over 4,100 stocks rising across the market. In terms of sectors, real estate, optical fiber concepts, CPO, communication equipment, and education led gains; oil and gas extraction and services, combustible ice, fentanyl, and coal mining and processing led declines. On the trading front, the real estate sector continued to rally in the afternoon, with Binjiang Group, Chengjian Development, Rongsheng Development, Zhongjiao Development, and Shoukai Co. hitting limit-up, while Tefa Services, Huayuan Holdings, and China Merchants Shekou led gains. The optical fiber concept was strong throughout the day, with Changjin Photon and Raybow Optoelectronics hitting 20cm limit-up, along with Zhichun Technology, Tongding Interconnect, and Yongding Shares.

headlines.title_en: A-share market review: ChiNext opens low, closes up 1.49%; large consumer sector moves up in afternoon.
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 12 - The A-share market opened low and moved higher today. After the afternoon session, the three major indices briefly narrowed gains after a surge, then regained momentum, with the ChiNext Index at one point rising over 2%. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.32%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.09%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.49%; turnover on the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets exceeded 2.1 trillion yuan, with over 3,800 stocks rising. On the trading front, computing hardware led the market, with optical fiber concepts and storage chips among the top gainers. Major consumer and real estate sectors continued to rally in the afternoon, with film and television performing actively, while oil and gas sectors stayed weak and led declines throughout the day.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 财政部拟发行2026年记账式贴现（五十期）国债

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discount bonds (50th tranche).
headlines.summary_en: This tranche of treasury bonds is a 91-day discount bond. The competitive bidding face value totals 30 billion yuan, with additional bidding allowed for Class A members. The issuance price is determined through competitive bidding, with bonds issued at a discount below the face value. Interest accrues from August 13, 2026, and repayment at face value is due on November 12, 2026 (postponed if a holiday).

headlines.title: 中国汽车工业协会：新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首超60%
headlines.summary: 中国汽车工业协会12日发布数据显示，2026年7月份，新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首次超过60%、累计占比首次超过50%；月度出口量连续两个月突破100万辆，新能源汽车出口占比连续两个月超过50%。前7个月，我国汽车产销分别完成1756.7万辆和1760.2万辆，其中新能源汽车产销分别完成901.4万辆和900.7万辆，同比增长均近10%。7月，新能源汽车产销分别完成157.6万辆和156.1万辆，同比分别增长26.8%和23.7%，纯电动汽车产销量均超过100万辆，同比增长均超过三成。

headlines.title_en: China Association of Automobile Manufacturers: New energy vehicle monthly new car sales share exceeds 60% for the first time.
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on the 12th shows that in July 2026, the share of new energy vehicles in monthly new car sales exceeded 60% for the first time, with the cumulative share exceeding 50% for the first time; monthly exports exceeded 1 million units for two consecutive months, with new energy vehicle exports accounting for over 50% for two consecutive months. In the first seven months, China's auto production and sales completed 17.567 million and 17.602 million units, respectively, with new energy vehicle production and sales completing 9.014 million and 9.007 million units, both growing nearly 10% year-on-year. In July, new energy vehicle production and sales completed 1.576 million and 1.561 million units, up 26.8% and 23.7% year-on-year, respectively, with pure electric vehicle production and sales both exceeding 1 million units, growing over 30% year-on-year.

Total market turnover hit 2.1672 trillion yuan, shrinking by 168.4 billion yuan from the prior day, with over 4,100 stocks advancing. Consumer sectors like baijiu and food strengthened in the afternoon, with Anji Video, Haoxiangni, and Baihe Shares hitting limit-up; components, PV equipment, and baijiu led gains.
